dct_description_sm:
Line feature layer representing mains, ditches and culverts that compose the storm water drainage infrastructure in the City of Barrie.
Relevant fields within the layer include (but not limited to): Type, Material, Shape, Size, Elevations, Watershed, Location, Owner, Status, Condition and Dates.

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca
